brief_title: Effects of Dipeptidyl Peptidase-4 (DPP-4) Inhibition on Hormonal Responses to Macronutrient Ingestion
official_title: Study of the Effect of Sitagliptin on the Hormonal Responses to Macronutrient Ingestion in Healthy Volunteers

primary_outcomes.measure: Glucagon-like Peptide-1 Secretion After Meal Ingestion

brief_summary: The regulation by DPP-4 inhibition after ingested of different individual macronutrients is not known. Therefore, this study examines the influence of ingestion of fat, protein, glucose or mixed meal on the concentrations of incretin hormones and insulin secretion with or without concomitant administration of a DPP-4 inhibitor (sitagliptin).

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy men
* Age 20-30 years
* BMI 20-30 kg/m2

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any disease
* Any medication

sites.facility: Department of Clinical Sciences Lund, Lund University
